input.reason: The step requires decoupler with CollecTRI. decoupler is not importable in the sandbox (ModuleNotFoundError). The R equivalent, decoupleR, is not available either. Three attempts to link them with link_packages (decoupler, anndata, decoupleR) all returned ERR_LINK_TIMEOUT ("the farm service did not answer"). That error means the link pass failed, not that the packages are absent from the pool. The inputs are fine: the CollecTRI regulons are at /mnt/refs/collectri/human/collectri.v1.tsv (columns source, target, weight), and the counts, sample sheet and T1S1 DE results are readable. I did not substitute a hand-written TF scoring method, because the constraint names decoupler. No TF activity table was produced. Re-run once the package link service responds.
